parent_title: PHASE8-IMPL-020 — Model-assisted evidence-backed extraction and diagnostic workflow
publication_summary: PHASE8-IMPL-020 is active as the next MVP-required parent after completed/PASS PHASE8-IMPL-019. PHASE8-IMPL-020-T001 is complete/PASS as docs/status publication only. PHASE8-IMPL-020-T002 is complete/PASS as docs/decision only with the accepted Model-assisted extraction and diagnostic workflow boundary decision. PHASE8-IMPL-020-T003 is complete/PASS as expected-red tests-only handoff at tests/test_writer_assistant_core_model_assisted_extraction_contract.py. PHASE8-IMPL-020-T004 is complete/PASS as minimal model-assisted request/output guard implementation at backend/story_knowledge/model_assisted_extraction.py, with pure side-effect-free request validation, environment validation, prompt-packet shaping, output validation, candidate-support shaping, diagnostic-question fallback, quarantine shaping, and guarded fail-closed execution shell APIs. PHASE8-IMPL-020-T005 is ready/active next. PHASE8-IMPL-020-T006 and PHASE8-IMPL-020-T007 are planned. Model-assisted evidence-backed extraction and diagnostic workflow may produce evidence-backed candidate observations, diagnostic questions, uncertainty notes, insufficient-evidence notes, safe refusal results, quarantined/fail-closed results, or candidate extraction support only. Required future output support includes source_refs, evidence_refs, provenance_refs, and source_locator_refs when available. Future requests must be path-safe, over owner-authored or owner-provided materials only, separate raw source text from user intent, and include no generated prose/no rewrite/no continuation/no outline/no training/no canon/no apply-promotion guard confirmations. Confidence is not truth; model output is not canon; no model output as truth; no automatic canon, no apply-promotion, no memory/canon mutation, no training artifacts, no generated prose, no rewrite, no continuation, no outline generation, fail closed, and no silent fallback. Owner review remains mandatory. Apply-promotion remains the separate explicit owner-confirmed path. T004 created no candidates, review queue entries, model calls, routes, UI, package changes, training artifacts, memory/canon mutation, apply-promotion, or generated prose. PHASE8-IMPL-021 and PHASE8-IMPL-022 remain future MVP-required parents. Fine-tuning remains deferred after MVP. Generated prose/prose-production paths remain permanently forbidden. PHASE8-UX-001 remains read-only terminology/boundary reference only.
